title: PACT Mandate
description: A handler-signed capability grant authorising one agent to negotiate inside one Parley within a bounded envelope. A Section 17-family object: signed by a HumanPrincipal under the strictly-1:1 model (17.4), alg drawn from the 17.6 whitelist, verified by the 17.7 flow applied to a broader-scope claim (20.5), fail-closed. Added in PACT v2.1 (Section 20).

mandate_id.description: Handler-minted identifier, unique per handler. Named in violation events and in parley-outcome.participants[].

parley_id.description: The Parley this Mandate authorises. REQUIRED on accept; absent on open (the Parley does not exist yet — the server binds the minted id per 20.5 step 7). A Mandate bearing a parley_id MUST NOT be accepted for any other Parley.

agent_id.description: The Section 23 agentId this Mandate authorises. A Mandate is not transferable between agents.

handler_principal_id.description: DID of the HumanPrincipal granting the Mandate (17.4 strictly-1:1).

identity_claim.description: Human-readable assertion of what the agent represents. Surfaced verbatim to counterparties in parley-state — this is what the other side is told it is talking to.

may_publish.description: Topic categories the agent may publish positions in. An operation outside these categories is a violation (19.7). MAY be empty — an agent that may say nothing is a listener.

boundary.description: A Section 10.3-style constraint: states the bound, not the reasoning behind it.

must_respect.description: Boundaries the agent must not cross. An unevaluable boundary is a violation, not a pass (20.7 step 5).

constraint_envelope.description: The negotiating envelope the server enforces on every operation (20.7).

max_binding_decisions.description: Cap on irreversible decisions this agent may make in the Parley.

binding_scope.description: What the agent may commit to. A commitment outside this scope is a violation.

commitment_authority.description: Absent → the agent has no commitment authority and any 'commitment' close is rejected. NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT for a binding outcome: the close itself must carry a per-handler 17.6 authorization_proof (19.8, SOQ4).

disclosure_ceiling.description: Maximum Section 10.3 graduated-disclosure level the agent may reach (1 Constraint, 2 Category, 3 Reasoning, 4 Human).

escalation_hook.description: Where outcomes and violation events are pushed, in the Section 21 signed-delivery envelope. MUST be https.

expires_at.description: Expiry in SERVER time (20.4). Skew window is the 17.7 step 4 window, ±5 minutes configurable — reused verbatim, not tightened.

credential_id.description: The enrolled credential that produced `signature`, resolvable under handler_principal_id per 17.8.

signing_key_id.description: Key identifier within the handler's DID Document.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. MUST be in the 17.6 normative whitelist; HMAC / symmetric-key algs are disallowed. Outside the whitelist → reject at 20.5 step 3.

alg_version.description: Version of `alg`. Suite revisions MUST NOT silently invalidate enrolled references.

signature.description: Signature over the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) encoding of the Mandate body with `signature` removed.

attestation_chain.description: Mandates are direct (1-hop) ONLY at v2.1 (20.8). A Mandate presented with a non-empty delegation chain MUST be rejected as unverifiable. Present for forward compatibility with 17.11.

examples.identity_claim: This agent represents Knox on API contract negotiation.

must_respect.boundary: No breaking changes to the event v1 schema
